summary: New gate doc_summaries (with its --self-test): fails when one C# doc comment under Assets/ carries two <summary> blocks, the stale doc of a member that moved or was deleted. The /ship SKILL.md section 2 bullet on this defect now points at the gate.
why: Garrett asked for it on 2026-11-11, after the /ship pass of cece/nifty-cray-41hy43 found 55 such stale docs on bleeding-edge. This branch fixes all 76 under Assets/ (docs only), so the gate starts green and keeps it that way. Port/ and Tools/ still carry 24; they are not gated, and 'check_doc_summaries.py --root Port --root Tools' lists them.
